description: Assess incomplete active plans as one batch, delegate conflict-aware dependency planning and native shared-branch implementation/review, then reassess and archive completed plans.

prompts.rielaPromptTemplate: Assess all incomplete active plans (or the explicitly requested single plan), pass their paths in one delegated request to codex-adversarial-implementation-review-loop, and let its design/implementation callee plan dependencies once and execute native fanout waves. Reassess only after the whole batch completes. Archive completed plans and finish when none remain.
prompts.workerSystemPromptTemplate: Return concise business JSON only. Keep selected plan path, delegated workflow input, delegated result, archived paths, active plans remaining, and residual risks explicit.

steps.description: Find the next incomplete active implementation plan, or report that active plans have no remaining incomplete work.
Package the selected active implementation plan as a request for codex-adversarial-implementation-review-loop.
Record the delegated codex-adversarial-implementation-review-loop result before reassessing active plans.
Move completed plans out of impl-plans/active and refresh plan indexes before final output.
Publish final evidence that no incomplete active implementation plans remain.
